title: Add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Priya Kapoor
description:
Motivation: Add opinionated RAG templates and agent/tool-calling quickstarts to make it easier for developers to get started with Retrieval-Augmented Generation patterns and tool-calling integrations using Redwood SDKs. This PR adds reusable RAG template examples (Python and TypeScript), an agents quickstart that demonstrates tool-calling + structured output, and updates the docs site navigation and quickstart index.

Summary of changes: add example repos under redwood-examples/rag-agents, add new quickstarts to docs (Getting Started -> Agents, RAG templates), update SDK example code for tool-calling, include screenshots for docs site, and add a CI docs build check.

Checklist:
- [x] Add RAG templates (Python + TS) and README walkthroughs
- [x] Add agent/tool-calling quickstart with example tools (search, calendar mock)
- [x] Update docs site nav and quickstart index
- [x] Add tests for example run scripts (smoke tests)
- [x] Address reviewer feedback and readability fixes

Notes: The quickstarts intentionally favor clear, minimal code and link to deeper examples in redwood-examples. References: ENG-8421 (RAG templates deliverable), DOCS-210 (quickstarts index refactor).

Omar Haddad: Linted the TS example and found an edge case where the SDK call returns a streaming error - added a suggestion to handle stream errors in the README and a small defensive try/catch in quickstart.ts.
